title: Built a 3D browser game for my clothing brand, would love feedback before launch
author: TJfron
selftext:
Wow, crazy we can do this now.

It’s always been my dream as a kid to make a game. I’ve had so much fun building this out over the past few months.

My name’s TJ, I run a clothing brand called Jabree. I started it 4 years ago and make ski outerwear, surf boardshorts and streetwear.

Ever since I started it I thought it would be the coolest idea to have a video game to elevate the brand experience. At first I started learning Godot to build an old Zelda style single player game, then realized I needed to work on growing the brand before trying to learn a completely new skill haha.

I just finished up a beta for the game I’ve been working on: [https://world.jabree.xyz/](https://world.jabree.xyz/)

I took inspiration from lobby style Minecraft servers like Hypixel with minigames + RuneScape world activities, and a fun play on action sports like skiing and skateboarding.

I built it all with Claude Opus 5.5 using Three.js in the browser. I used Gemini for concept art, Tripo for the character and 3D assets, and Blender with a Mixamo rig for the animations.

You earn XP from the world games and minigames as you level up, and it ties into my brand’s loyalty rewards.

Working on player models and the 3D assets for clothes is my next big step. If anyone has a good AI workflow for that, lmk!

I’m excited to see how my customers will react to this as an expansion of the brand, but wanted to get some feedback from the game dev community first before doing a full release around Christmas time.
